name: thinkcell-mcp
description: Build real, editable think-cell charts and decks in PowerPoint from plain data.
long_description:
Turns data into think-cell slides through think-cell's own JSON automation (ppttc): bar, stacked, line, waterfall, Mekko, scatter, area, combo, table and process charts, or whole decks with no template setup. It can also fill any chart from think-cell's own chart library, or a slide of your own saved as a template. It can read data from Excel or CSV and insert the finished slides into the deck open in PowerPoint; the charts stay editable in think-cell.

Needs Windows, PowerPoint and a licensed think-cell install with JSON data automation (think-cell AI Suite in the current manual). Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by think-cell Sales GmbH & Co. KG.
